summary: Turn a completed meeting into grounded decisions, actions, follow-up drafts, and proposed updates to the right systems.

useCases.title: Debrief a completed meeting
useCases.message: Use the reliable meeting record to show what changed, what was decided, who committed to what, and which follow-up or system updates I should review.

useCases.title: Turn a meeting into follow-through
useCases.message: Prepare a concise debrief from this meeting, including decisions, commitments, open questions, and the useful next actions.

useCases.title: Turn an investment meeting into evidence and next steps
useCases.message: Use the reliable meeting record to capture what changed in the investment view, the evidence and questions that surfaced, commitments, and the follow-through I should review.

useCases.title: Debrief a client or delivery meeting
useCases.message: Turn this reliable meeting record into grounded decisions, commitments, actions, follow-up drafts, and proposed engagement updates.

useCases.title: Debrief a general sales-team meeting
useCases.message: Turn this internal, partner, or cross-functional meeting into grounded decisions, commitments, actions, and follow-up drafts. Use the Sales debrief when commercial and CRM judgment dominates.

useCases.title: Capture decisions and next steps
useCases.message: Turn this transcript or set of notes into a grounded recap, owned actions, follow-up drafts, and proposed record changes.

useCases.title: Capture what a critique decided
useCases.message: Turn this design review into the decisions, the open questions, and who owns what next.

useCases.title: Capture what a data review decided
useCases.message: Turn this review into decisions, follow-up questions, and the analysis someone still owes.
